title: The Closed Range Property and Gaffney's Inequality of the De Rham Complex in Unbounded Domains
summary: The classical Poincaré estimate establishes closedness of the range of the gradient in unweighted $L^2(Ω)$-spaces as long as $Ω\subseteq\mathbb{R}^3$ is contained in a slab, that is, $Ω$ is bounded in one direction. Here, as a main observation, we provide closed range results for the $\operatorname{rot}$-operator, if (and only if) $Ω$ is bounded in two directions. Along the way, we characterise closed range results for all the differential operators of the primal and dual de Rham complex in terms of directions of boundedness of the underlying domain.
